## About
Jim Suny's Auto Specialists is a neighborhood repair shop on West Chester Pike in Upper Darby Township. Jim and his son Greg look after everyday maintenance and the bigger repairs too, from tune-ups and brake work to cooling, electrical and engine problems.
Our goal is simple: do good work at reasonable prices and build a relationship with you that lasts. We'd rather earn a customer for years than make a quick sale.
Drivers have given us a 4.7 rating across 58 Google reviews, and we work hard to keep earning it.

## Services
- Oil changes and tune-ups: Routine maintenance to keep your engine running smoothly.
- Brake system repair: Brake work, including brake lines, done carefully so you can stop with confidence.
- Computer diagnostics: We read your car's computer to track down warning lights and problems.
- Engine repair and replacement: From performance checks to full engine repair or replacement.
- Air conditioning service and repair: Keep your air conditioning blowing cold through the summer.
- Electrical system diagnosis and repair: Battery, wiring and other electrical issues found and fixed.
- Suspension and steering service and repair: Service and repair for a smoother, steadier ride.
- Cooling systems service and repair: Help keeping your engine from running hot.
- Factory schedule maintenance: Maintenance that follows your car's factory schedule.
- Pre-purchase inspections: Have us look over a used car before you buy it.

## FAQ
Q: Are you open on Saturday?
A: Yes, Saturday mornings from 8:00 AM to 12:00 PM. We're closed Sunday.

Q: Can you check out a used car before I buy it?
A: Yes. We do pre-purchase inspections so you know what you're getting before you sign.

Q: Can you figure out why my check engine light is on?
A: We offer computer diagnostics and a complete engine performance check to find out what's going on.
